description: This file defines the ModeratedNodeListBuilder class, which extends NodeListBuilder to create a listing of moderated node entities in Drupal, including methods for loading revisions, building headers and rows, and rendering the list.

classes.description: Class for building a list of moderated node entities with custom loading, header, row, and render methods.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the list builder with entity type, storage, date formatter, redirect destination, and entity type manager.

methods.name: createInstance
methods.description: Factory method to create an instance of the list builder using dependency injection container.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads entity revisions based on IDs retrieved from getEntityRevisionIds.

methods.name: getEntityRevisionIds
methods.description: Builds and executes a query to retrieve revision IDs of content moderation states that are not published, optionally paginated.

methods.name: buildHeader
methods.description: Builds table header with an additional 'Moderation state' column.

methods.name: buildRow
methods.description: Builds a table row for an entity, including its moderation state.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the list, providing a message if no moderated entities are found.
